title: Top 10 Essential Verbs in English, Part 2 (CEFR A0–A1 / A2)
dek: Master the second 10 high-frequency verbs in English (do/make, speak/talk/say/tell, look/watch/see, listen/hear, must/have to, take/give/get, live, wait, understand, ask/answer). Conjugation tables on COSYtools.

blocks.text: Welcome to Part 2 of our 2-part core verb series for A0–A1 and A2 English learners! (Read [Part 1](top-10-verbs-en.html) if you missed it). Here we cover 10 core action, perception, and modal verbs. All conjugation tables and verb forms are consultable on [COSYtools](https://cosylanguages.github.io/COSYtools/).

items:
**1. Do / Make:** Activities and creation.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I do my homework' vs 'I make breakfast'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'do business', 'do research' | 'make progress', 'make a mistake'.

**2. Speak / Talk / Say / Tell:** Communication.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I speak English', 'Let's talk', 'Say hello', 'Tell me'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'speak fluently', 'talk with', 'say yes', 'tell a story'.

**3. Look / Watch / See:** Vision and attention.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'Look at this', 'Watch a movie', 'I see a bird'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'look for', 'look forward to', 'watch out', 'see you soon'.

**4. Listen / Hear:** Listening and perception.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'Listen to music', 'Did you hear that?'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'listen carefully', 'hear from', 'glad to hear that'.

**5. Must / Have To:** Necessity and obligation.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I must study', 'We have to leave now'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'must be', 'have to go', 'don't have to'.

**6. Take / Give / Get:** Exchange and receiving.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'Take a coat', 'Give me a hand', 'Get home'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'take care', 'give up', 'get tired', 'get ready'.

**7. Live:** Residence and lifestyle.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I live in London', 'She lives with her family'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'live abroad', 'live well', 'live together'.

**8. Wait:** Patience and time.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'Wait for the bus', 'Can you wait a minute?'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'wait for', 'wait in line', 'can't wait'.

**9. Understand:** Comprehension.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I understand', 'Do you understand me?'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'make yourself understood', 'as I understand', 'fully understand'.

**10. Ask / Answer:** Questions and answers.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'Ask a question', 'Answer the phone'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'ask for help', 'answer questions', 'ask a favour'.

blocks.text: Grammar & Structure for A0–A1 / A2 Learners

• **Simple Sentence Structures:** Focus on Subject + Verb + Object.
• **Auxiliaries & Modals:** Use 'can', 'must', and 'be going to' for simple daily intentions.
• **Conjugations:** Check full present, past, and future tense tables on [COSYtools](https://cosylanguages.github.io/COSYtools/).
